rules: Quarantined work needs a new exact recovery operation.
Transfer requires all participant freeze and commit witnesses.
Replays are checked before new-admission expiry/generation checks.

An accepted request identity and its exact immutable payload identity remain reserved for the lifetime of its owner epoch, including after terminal Operation history is pruned. Exact accepted replay resolves to the retained outcome before new-admission checks; the identity is never admitted again as fresh work.

History retention and request deduplication are independent. Collection may compact terminal detail into a retained replay record, but must preserve original attribution, payload identity, terminal state and effect certainty, required Plan/result custody, and unresolved holds. Explicit receiver capacity may refuse new identities; it never evicts accepted identity reservations to admit more work.

A restored owner epoch does not recreate historical acceptance authority. Historical request identities, original outcomes and workflow recovery lineage remain attributable to their original epochs; current-authority recovery uses new exact identities.

owner_meanings.accepted: The local owner has durably accepted responsibility for this exact request. Execution has not been established as complete.
owner_meanings.running: The owner is executing accepted work. Losing the client connection does not stop it.
owner_meanings.waiting: Accepted work is waiting for a prerequisite or an owner-controlled continuation. It is not a failed or new request.
owner_meanings.succeeded: The owner has verified the requested result and its effects. This does not establish unrelated app health or backup recoverability.
owner_meanings.failed: This operation ended without the requested result. Confirmed or unknown effects and their holds remain until resolved by the owner.
owner_meanings.cancelled: The owner ended this operation after cancellation. This does not undo effects, prove every participant stopped, or release retained holds.
owner_meanings.quarantined: This operation has ended with unresolved conditions that block further changes. A new exact recovery operation must resolve them; retrying as fresh work is unsafe.

client_meanings.prepared: A local request identity is ready to send. No owner acceptance, reservation or durable client storage is implied.
client_meanings.acceptance_unknown: The request may have been accepted. Query or reconcile the original owner and request identity.
client_meanings.accepted: Owner evidence establishes acceptance. Consult the separate Operation receipt for progress and outcome.
client_meanings.rejected: An authenticated owner response explicitly refused acceptance. A timeout or unreadable response is not rejection.
